name: node-svelte-clean-template
description: Template: layered Fastify API + SvelteKit SPA, with deploy pipelines and architecture skills

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix api ci && npm --prefix web ci
scripts.test: npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix api run test:integration && npm --prefix web test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix api run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run check && npm test
